title: Helping personal agents shop more intelligently and reliably with Link
quote: Over the past month, agentic purchases made with Link increased 38x. Popular agents like Muse, Grok Bot, and Instinct are already using Link's wallet for agents.

title: Stripe hands AI agents a wallet, ushering in agentic purchasing
quote: Stripe unveiled Link's wallet for agents on April 29, 2026, enabling AI systems to shop, book reservations, and pay bills while keeping actual card and bank credentials hidden.

title: OpenAI launches Dots, its bubbly agentic avatar
quote: Dots are always-on agents built to handle everything ... employing a bubbly, cartoonish persona, similar to Meta's recently released Muse agent.

title: OpenAI's latest features take direct aim at the app store model
quote: Sign in with ChatGPT ... 16 launch partners including Notion, Vercel, and Figma ... OpenAI Marketplace launched with 30+ partners.

title: OpenAI launches Sign in with ChatGPT as identity layer for apps
quote: Signing in does not independently expose ChatGPT conversations, memory, files, tokens, billing information or other account data. Applications can ask for more access through a separate permissions flow.

title: Stripe built the most comprehensive agent payment stack in fintech. The agents aren't spending.
quote: A Product.ai survey from April 2026 found only 14% of consumers trust AI to execute purchases without verification, and 42% refuse to trust AI for transactions over $25.
